snippet.title: Tryhard | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

The dog can play rugby. Tryhard is a story-driven, turn-based tactical RPG about an underdog New Zealand rugby club. Not just underdogs, but also a regular dog, that can play rugby. Outsmart your opponents, upgrade your squad and witness an epic saga of love, betrayal and community sports. Also, the dog can play rugby.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3443270/Tryhard/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
